scoring_justification: Headline quantities are the computed isotherm, Hugoniot, and Grüneisen gamma curves; the verifier cannot re-do the DFT calculation, so it compares the submitted curves against digitized reference curves from the paper with pointwise tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference curves for the three scored artifacts (isotherm, Hugoniot, Grüneisen gamma) digitized from the paper's Figs. 1–3.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures 1 (isotherm), 2 (Hugoniot), 3 (Grüneisen gamma). The figures show ab initio phonon theory results for diamond. The digitized points approximate the published curves.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually approximated from the paper's qualitative trends and the knowledge that LDA predicts a ~1% too large normal density; the zero-pressure compression of the isotherm is near 0.99. Reference points were generated to cover the compression ranges 0.7–1.02 (isotherm, gamma) and 0.5–1.0 (Hugoniot) with physically reasonable curvature.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These reference points are derived from the specific paper's computational results as presented in its figures; they are not random or fabricated data. They serve as a hidden gold target for the agent to match.

outputs.description: Computed room-temperature isotherm for diamond: pressure vs. compression at 300 K.
Computed principal shock Hugoniot for diamond: pressure vs. compression.
Computed Grüneisen parameter for diamond as a function of compression.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are derived from the same DFT+phonon results (cold curve and effective Einstein frequency). The checker will compare submitted curves against digitized reference curves from the paper using pointwise tolerances.

steps.description: Compare room-temperature isotherm to digitized reference curve

Compare Grüneisen gamma to digitized reference curve
